title: Firework Trades
description: Adds firework trades to fletcher villagers
body:
This plugin allows fletcher villagers to sell firework rockets for emeralds, making you not have to grind creepers!

### **Available trades:**


**Fletcher (Level 2)** - 32x Dura 1 Fireworks for 15 Emeralds.

**Fletcher (Level 3)** - 24x Dura 2 Fireworks for 20 Emeralds.

**Fletcher (Level 4)** - 16x Dura 3 Fireworks for 25 Emeralds
